name: SINC
source:
Earth is on the brink of destruction, and a small pawnshop with an illegal implant surgery backroom becomes humanity’s last hope.
The planet is about to be destroyed over an unpaid galactic debt, and a charming alien debt collector is ready to accept payment — not in money, but in human souls.
The protagonist must uncover what a soul truly is… and take it from seven girls.
